service.ur: زبانی جانچ کا وقت مقرر کرنا

about: Book the oral assessment that some healthcare professionals need to finish DHA registration.
note: Requirements read from the official DHA service page on the checked date. DHA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Opens only after DHA has reviewed your registration or upgrade request and an oral assessment is required
You must not be suspended, revoked or blacklisted
fees: AED 250 for allied health, nurses and traditional medicine
